ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.18:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense high-intensity clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips; extensive random distribution of linear and punctate white intensities across the primary dark-pixel lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, most pronounced on the inner-half of both trailing margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex trajectory tapering into acute, outward-reaching points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe rake-mark scarring across both fluke lobes and heavy biological encrustation on the distal margins.
